description: This file contains test classes and functions for the QUIC protocol implementation, including a custom server session, dispatcher, and test server setup, along with test-specific session behavior.

classes.name: CustomStreamSession
classes.description: A custom server session class that creates streams using provided factories and manages crypto streams.

classes.name: QuicTestDispatcher
classes.description: A test dispatcher class that creates and manages QUIC server sessions, supporting custom session, stream, and crypto stream factories.

classes.name: QuicTestServer
classes.description: A test server class that sets up the dispatcher and allows configuration of session, stream, and event loop factories.

classes.name: ImmediateGoAwaySession
classes.description: A test session that immediately sends a GOAWAY frame upon certain events, used for testing.

methods.name: CreateIncomingStream
methods.description: Creates an incoming stream, either via factory or default implementation.

methods.name: CreateQuicCryptoServerStream
methods.description: Creates a crypto stream, either via factory or default.

methods.name: CreateQuicSession
methods.description: Creates a new QUIC session, either default or custom, based on factory settings.

methods.name: SetSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the custom session factory for the dispatcher.

methods.name: SetStreamFactory
methods.description: Sets the custom stream factory for the dispatcher.

methods.name: SetCryptoStreamFactory
methods.description: Sets the custom crypto stream factory for the dispatcher.

methods.name: CreateQuicDispatcher
methods.description: Creates and returns a new test dispatcher instance.

methods.name: SetSessionFactory
methods.description: Configures the server to use a custom session factory.

methods.name: SetSpdyStreamFactory
methods.description: Configures the server to use a custom stream factory.

methods.name: SetCryptoStreamFactory
methods.description: Configures the server to use a custom crypto stream factory.

methods.name: SetEventLoopFactory
methods.description: Sets a custom event loop factory.

methods.name: CreateEventLoop
methods.description: Creates a new event loop, either custom or default.

methods.name: OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming stream frames, sending GOAWAY if needed.

methods.name: OnCryptoFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming crypto frames, possibly sending GOAWAY.

methods.name: OnNewEncryptionKeyAvailable
methods.description: Handles the event of a new encryption key being available, potentially sending GOAWAY.
